enchantment.whipsandgiggles.grappling.de: Fully charge right-click to reel a struck entity or grapple a block. Sneak to detach. Incompatible with Piercing.
enchantment.whipsandgiggles.piercing.des: Strikes one additional entity per level along the lash. Incompatible with Grappling.
enchantment.whipsandgiggles.reach.desc: Adds 3 blocks of lash and grappling reach per level. Compatible with Grappling and Piercing.
